about.headline: Bureaucracy affects us all – share your frustration with us!
about.description:
We all know the frustration when bureaucratic hurdles make everyday life difficult: long waiting times, confusing forms, or opaque decisions. That's exactly why we created this platform. Here you can easily report your experiences and problems with authorities and administration.

Our goal is to work together with you to show where the shoe pinches – regardless of political background or opinion. Because bureaucracy should not be an obstacle, but a service for all citizens.

This initiative is supported by committed members of the FDP Hessen, who advocate for more transparency and efficiency in administration. We take your reports seriously, investigate the problems, and regularly report here on the current status and possible solutions.

We are pleased if you raise your voice and participate – only together can we bring about change.
